parts.text: State what is meant by the binding energy of a nucleus.

parts.label: (b)
(c)(i)
parts.part_stem:
The nuclide lanthanum-141 ($^{141}_{57}$La) has a half-life of 3.9 hours.

Initially, a radioactive source contains only lanthanum-141. The initial activity of the source is $A_0$.
parts.text: Calculate the time for the activity of the lanthanum-141 to be reduced to $0.40A_0$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest why the total activity of the radioactive source measured at the time calculated in (i) may be greater than $0.40A_0$.
